purpose: One-time generated, label-separated confirmatory challenge after validation candidate selection. Not official bAbI test data. Task 11 adds an explicit model-visible gender feature in a controlled synthetic input schema.

generation_policy.entity_policy: Novel entity/location tokens generated per story; no overlap with official-test labels or training story identifiers

task11.input_schema: Task11MentionEvent runtime-compatible schema: event_id, surface_mention, is_pronoun, grammatical_gender, location, observed_at, source_ref; query: query_id, task_id, entity, observed_at, source_ref
task11.construction: Exactly two novel entity anchors with distinct model-visible grammatical-gender cues; every she/he pronoun has exactly one compatible prior name anchor
task11.label_policy: Antecedent is the most recent prior explicit name anchor for the uniquely compatible gender; target name anchors use self_anchor, not a coreference edge
task11.scope_note: The gender cue is a synthetic input feature and is not claimed to be present in raw bAbI text

generation_policy.task14: Shuffled source-order temporal observations with explicit ordinal anchor features; before-destination query; labels include predecessor/target witness events
generation_policy.task19: Novel directed spatial chain and ordered route query; labels include direction sequence and supporting edge IDs
generation_policy.evaluator_separation: Inputs and evaluator labels are distinct JSONL files; evaluator-only coreference edges and target bundles cannot cross the runtime ingestion boundary
generation_policy.no_training_access: Generated-confirmatory labels are never provided to warm-start or online-adaptation phases. They are read only after validation candidate selection.

source_claim_boundary: A generated challenge validates transfer only to this separate synthetic distribution; it is not an official bAbI benchmark result and is not a substitute for the frozen official-test policy.
freeze_note: Protocol v1.1 replaces the non-identifiable Task 11 generated challenge from v1.0. The exact generated files are fixed by this protocol, generator and seed schedule; runtime manifests record SHA-256 for input and evaluator-label files.
